story: Nia noticed the thirsty tomato seedlings. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” Nia said, “I can water the tomato seedlings.” Nia used the watering can to water the tomato seedlings. The shade cloth fell. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie because the tomato seedlings were exposed. Mr Bell repaired the tap. Mrs Okafor used the clip to repair the shade cloth. Nia watered the sunflower. Nia returned the watering can to Mr Bell. The tomato seedlings stood under the repaired shade cloth.
